Adaptive experimentation is the machine-learning guided process of iteratively exploring a (possibly infinite) parameter space in order to identify optimal configurations in a resource-efficient manner. Ax currently supports Bayesian optimization and bandit optimization as exploration strategies. Bayesian optimization in Ax is powered by [BoTorch](https://github.com/facebookexternal/botorch), a modern library for Bayesian optimization research built on PyTorch. For full documentation and tutorials, see the [Ax website](https://ax.dev) ## Why Ax? - **Expressive API**: Ax has an expressive API that can address many real-world optimization tasks.
